items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: I took this gig from George Williams. George Williams had a brass band.

ctx.x: Was he thinking more music or more better money? Or maybe something more steady? Well, he. Stable. Than that rock and gold. I don't think.

Yeah, right. Exactly. It was a little bit more stable and all that kind of stuff. But musically, he liked all kinds of music, you know. So, but musically, the music he wanted me to go down and play in the French Quarter and so forth and so on, was the better music. You know what I'm saying? He said, that's moist. It was better. You know? I found out. It was right. Oh yeah, I found out it was right. Sure. So I did take upon his advice. And I took this gig from George Williams. George Williams had a brass band.…
First time you played in the parade?
